description: Stops an analysis package for good. Refund rule: if the work failed on our side (`refund_on_cancel` true in qualitative_get_run), the whole package price is refunded to the credit balance; cancelling a healthy or still running package refunds nothing and the charge stays; a completed package cannot be cancelled. Ask the user before cancelling. Requires sign-in (OAuth connector or API key) with the runs:write scope, and the key's owner must own the analysis. It does not delete the analysis or its data. To resume failed work without cancelling use qualitative_retry_analysis.

idempotency_key.description: Optional key (printable ASCII, at most 255 characters). Pass idempotency_key to make your own retries safe: repeating the call with the same key returns the original result instead of acting again. If omitted, every call gets its own fresh key.

run_id.description: The analysis id (`run_id`) from qualitative_list_runs or qualitative_start_analysis.

name: qualitative_cancel_analysis
title: Cancel an analysis
